fallbackMessage: I'm not sure about that one — leave your email and our team will get back to you.
notes: Matching is by MEANING (embeddings), not exact words. GUARDRAILS = keyword → moderation API (free, universal safety) → embeddings (store-specific). CURATED = embeddings; score >= curatedMatchThreshold uses it directly; score between curatedBorderline and curatedMatchThreshold asks the LLM to confirm; below curatedBorderline is skipped. bannedMatchThreshold: meaning-closeness to block a banned topic. minMeaningScore: strength a product/knowledge match must have. Tune to taste.
